args.summary: Reports: Markdown in reports/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md, starting with a TL;DR line
args.content: When the user asks for a report, save it as Markdown in reports/ named YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md (today's date) and start it with a one-line TL;DR.

args.command: mkdir -p reports && printf 'TL;DR: 11 TODOs, most in src/sync.py.\n' > "reports/$(date +%Y-%m-%d)-todos.md"
